# Comparisons

This folder contains the structured comparison tables and analytical articles extracted from the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) annual reports. It serves as the primary repository for evaluating clinical quality indicators, mortality outcomes, surgical timelines, and patient demographics across Danish regions and individual hospitals. By synthesizing data on antibiotic administration, CT scanning bottlenecks, postoperative mobilization, and comorbidity-stratified survival rates, these pages provide a comprehensive, citation-backed map of acute abdominal surgery performance in Denmark.

## Pages

- [[30-dages-mortalitet-blandt-opererede-patienter-med-charlson-score-0|30-dages mortalitet blandt opererede patienter med Charlson Score = 0]] — Compares 30-day mortality rates for acute surgery patients with no comorbidities across Danish regions and hospitals.
- [[aarsag-danmark-hovedstaden-sjaelland-syddanmark-midtjylland-nordjylland|Årsag Danmark Hovedstaden Sjælland Syddanmark Midtjylland Nordjylland]] — Breaks down the specific reasons for patient exclusion from Indicator 8 across national and regional levels.
- [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] — Tracks the longitudinal volume of operated versus non-operated patients registered in the Acute Surgery Database over multiple years.
- [[andel-opererede-og-ikke-opererede-patienter|Andel opererede og ikke-opererede patienter]] — Compares the proportion of acute patients receiving surgical intervention versus non-operative management across regions and hospitals.
- [[eksklusion-aarsag|"Eksklusion: Årsag"]] — Details the national and regional counts of patients excluded from Indicator 8 based on administrative and clinical criteria.
- [[eksklusion-ugyldigt-cpr-nummer-under-18-aar-ikke-opereret-osv|"Eksklusion: Ugyldigt CPR-nummer, under 18 år, ikke opereret, osv."]] — Catalogs exclusion volumes for Indicator 9, highlighting non-operated patients as the overwhelming majority of excluded cases.
- [[eksklusion|Eksklusion]] — Analyzes exclusion reasons for Indicators 9 and 10, showing consistent regional hierarchies in patient filtering.
- [[eksklusionsaarsager-for-indikator-3|Eksklusionsårsager for Indikator 3]] — Examines why patients are excluded from Indicator 3 (preoperative optimization/CT scanning), dominated by non-operative cases.
- [[eksklusionsgrunde-for-indikator-6-paa-regionalt-niveau|Eksklusionsgrunde for indikator 6 på regionalt niveau]] — Breaks down regional exclusion volumes for Indicator 6 (early mobilization), emphasizing clinical pathway filters.
- [[fordeling-af-alder-for-opererede-01-09-2022-31-08-2023|"Fordeling af alder for opererede, 01/09/2022 - 31/08/2023"]] — Provides a statistical distribution of patient ages, including quartiles and medians, for acute surgeries performed in 2022–2023.
- [[indikator-1-antibiotikabehandling-indenfor-3-timer-regional-og-hospitalsmaessig-opfyldelse|"Indikator 1: Antibiotikabehandling indenfor 3 timer — Regional og hospitalsmæssig opfyldelse"]] — Measures regional and hospital-level compliance with the target of administering antibiotics within three hours of arrival.
- [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] — Compares historical and current fulfillment rates for timely antibiotic administration across all Danish acute surgery departments.
- [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] — Tracks 90-day postoperative mortality rates for all operated acute patients against the national threshold.
- [[indikator-10c|Indikator 10c]] — Evaluates 30-day mortality for highly comorbid patients (Charlson Score ≥ 3) across regions and hospitals.
- [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] — Assesses the proportion of patients receiving a CT scan within 120 minutes of hospital arrival.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Measures compliance with preoperative optimization or direct transfer to surgery within four hours of arrival.
- [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] — Compares the proportion of acute patients operated on within six hours of arrival among those operated within 24 hours.
- [[indikator-4x|Indikator 4x]] — Evaluates timely surgery (within 6 hours) specifically for high-risk patients presenting with perforation, ischemia, or bleeding.
- [[indikator-4y|Indikator 4y]] — Tracks the proportion of non-high-risk patients (without perforation/ischemia) operated on within 24 hours of arrival.
- [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] — Measures the proportion of elderly or severely ill patients (ASA ≥ 3) monitored in intermediate care for at least 24 hours postoperatively.
- [[indikator-5x|Indikator 5x]] — Compares regional and hospital performance on emergency surgery timelines for critical abdominal conditions.
- [[indikator-5y|Indikator 5y]] — Analyzes fulfillment rates for timely surgery in non-critical acute abdominal cases across regions.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Tracks the national and regional rates of early postoperative mobilization within 24 hours of surgery.
- [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] — Compares the utilization of epidural anesthesia during acute abdominal surgeries across Danish hospitals.
- [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] — Evaluates 30-day postoperative mortality for all operated acute patients against the <12% national target.
- [[indikator-9b|Indikator 9b]] — Details 30-day mortality specifically for patients with mild-to-moderate comorbidities (Charlson Score 1 or 2).
- [[indikator-9c|Indikator 9c]] — Assesses 30-day mortality for patients with severe comorbidities (Charlson Score ≥ 3).
- [[indikatorer-for-akutte-hoejrisiko-abdominalkirurgiske-patienter-paa-danske-sygehuse|Indikatorer for akutte højrisiko abdominalkirurgiske patienter på danske sygehuse]] — Summarizes exclusion criteria and baseline metrics for high-risk acute abdominal patients across regions.
- [[indikatoropfyldelse-efter-region-og-hospital|Indikatoropfyldelse efter region og hospital]] — Provides a comprehensive breakdown of Indicator 1 (antibiotics) fulfillment rates by region and individual hospital.
- [[median-tid-fra-ankomst-til-sygehus-til-modtagelse-af-antibiotika-minutter|Median tid fra ankomst til sygehus til modtagelse af antibiotika (minutter)]] — Compares the median time and interquartile ranges for antibiotic administration across hospitals.
- [[median-tid-til-antibiotika-modtagelse-efter-ankomst-til-sygehus|Median tid til antibiotika-modtagelse efter ankomst til sygehus]] — Analyzes the statistical distribution of wait times for antibiotics, highlighting severe delays at major university hospitals.
- [[median-tid-til-ct-scanning-minutter|Median tid til CT-scanning (minutter)]] — Measures the median wait time for CT scanning, identifying significant bottlenecks at facilities like Rigshospitalet.
- [[opgoerelse-af-indlaeggelsesperiode-for-01-09-2022-31-08-2023|Opgørelse af indlæggelsesperiode for 01/09/2022–31/08/2023]] — Compares the statistical distribution of hospital admission lengths for acute surgeries in the 2022–2023 period.
- [[opgoerelse-af-indlaeggelsesperiode-for-01-09-2023-31-08-2024|Opgørelse af indlæggelsesperiode for 01/09/2023–31/08/2024]] — Tracks admission length quartiles for the 2023–2024 period, noting extended stays at tertiary centers.
- [[oversigt-over-alle-indikatorer|Oversigt over alle indikatorer]] — Lists the definitions, formats, and national standard thresholds for all 10 core clinical quality indicators.
- [[oversigt-over-de-samlede-indikatorresultater|Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater]] — Presents a consolidated national view of all indicator fulfillment rates across three consecutive reporting periods.
- [[resultater-for-indikator-11-mortalitet-indenfor-90-dage-efter-akut-kirurgi|"Resultater for Indikator 11: Mortalitet indenfor 90 dage efter akut kirurgi"]] — Evaluates 90-day mortality rates for acute surgery patients against the <20% national standard.
- [[resultater-for-supplerende-indikator-til-indikator-9c-mortalitet-indenfor-30-dage-efter-akut-kirurgi-charlson-score-3|"Resultater for supplerende indikator til indikator 9c: Mortalitet indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi, Charlson Score ≥ 3"]] — Details 30-day mortality outcomes for the highly comorbid patient subpopulation (Charlson ≥ 3).
- [[supplerende-analyse-af-epidural-ved-laparoskopi-delpopulation-af-indikator-8|Supplerende analyse af epidural ved laparoskopi (delpopulation af indikator 8 )]] — Compares the use of epidural anesthesia specifically during laparoscopic procedures across regions.
- [[supplerende-analyse-af-epidural-ved-laparotomi-aaben-delpopulation-af-indikator-8|Supplerende analyse af epidural ved laparotomi (åben) (delpopulation af indikator 8)]] — Analyzes epidural utilization rates during open laparotomies, showing high regional variance.
- [[supplerende-indikator-til-10b-mortalitet-indenfor-30-dage-efter-akut-kirurgi-hvis-charlson-score-1-eller-2-alle-opererede|"Supplerende indikator til 10b: Mortalitet indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi, hvis Charlson Score = 1 eller 2. Alle opererede."]] — Tracks 30-day mortality for patients with mild-to-moderate comorbidities (Charlson 1-2) as a supplement to Indicator 10.
- [[supplerende-indikator-til-indikator-9a-mortalitet-indenfor-30-dage-efter-akut-kirurgi-hvis-charlson-score-0-alle-opererede|"Supplerende indikator til indikator 9a: Mortalitet indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi, hvis Charlson Score = 0. Alle opererede."]] — Evaluates 30-day mortality for patients with no registered comorbidities (Charlson 0).
- [[supplerende-indikator-til-indikator-9b-mortalitet-indenfor-30-dage-efter-akut-kirurgi-hvis-charlson-score-1-eller-2-alle-opererede|"Supplerende indikator til indikator 9b: Mortalitet indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi, hvis Charlson Score = 1 eller 2. Alle opererede."]] — Assesses 30-day mortality for the Charlson 1-2 subpopulation as a supplement to Indicator 9.
- [[supplerende-opgoerelse-af-asa-score-for-opererede-boxplot|"Supplerende opgørelse af ASA-score for opererede, boxplot"]] — Compares the regional distribution of ASA physical status scores for acute surgery patients.
- [[supplerende-opgoerelse-over-fordelingen-af-cancer-01-09-2022-31-08-2023|Supplerende opgørelse over fordelingen af cancer 01.09.2022 - 31.08.2023]] — Breaks down the proportion of acute surgery patients presenting with gastrointestinal, gynecological, or other cancers versus no cancer diagnosis.
- [[supplerende-opgoerelse-over-indlaeggelsesperiode|Supplerende opgørelse over indlæggelsesperiode]] — Provides a supplementary statistical breakdown of hospital stay durations, highlighting extreme outliers at tertiary hospitals.
